subject: Acme Corp - Buying process & procurement exception (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Acme discovery recap + next steps (procurement path & stakeholder mapping)

Hi Sophie / Raj -

Great to speak with you both earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

Summary of needs:
- Primary use: customer support summarization + routing (high QPS during peak)
- Latency target: <250ms 95th for short prompts
- Cost sensitivity: focused on per-token cost at scale
- Security/contract requirements: SOC2 evidence, data retention 90 days, VPC option for production

Stakeholders we identified:
- Economic buyer: Raj Patel (you confirmed)
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com (procurement lead will own PO and contract cadence)
- Legal: will need to review standard T&Cs and any SLA exceptions
- Security: will want SOC2 report, encryption/KMS details

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm procurement contact and expected timeline for PO?
2) Sophie, you mentioned a procurements form for exceptions - please share so we can complete it (I've attached a short MAP for context).
3) We have a typical path for any discount or SLA exceptions: internal approval -> security/legal review -> sign. I'm going to start that loop internally for a potential procurement exception (discount + SLA term).

I’ll follow up internally and loop in sales ops and security. If you can share the procurement contact and any internal deadlines that would be super helpful.

Attachments: acme-MAP-v1.pdf (one-page value map)

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme discovery recap + next steps (procurement path & stakeholder mapping)

Marissa - thank you for the clear recap.

A few quick notes:
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com is the right inbox. Our lead (Maya Singh) will be the reviewer. Typical timeline is 2-3 weeks for standard deals, longer if exceptions are requested.
- Legal: will be involved if SLA or data residency exceptions are requested. We usually route legal in parallel with procurement but they have final signoff.
- Economic buyer: yes, Raj is the approver for budget.

I've attached our procurement requirements (procurement_requirements.pdf) - it lists the docs they need (SOC2, sample contracts, billing contact). I’ll introduce Maya on the procurement thread after you’ve submitted the form.

We’re aiming to close before the end of Q1; procurement deadlines are flexible if we can provide the required security artifacts and an exception justification.

Best,
Sophie
Sr. Product Ops
Acme Corp

--
Attachment: procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@acme.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:00:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Acme procurement exception request - discount + SLA (requesting approval)

Team -

Following the discovery with Acme (Sophie & Raj), they've asked us to submit a procurement exception for a combination of pricing discount and a shortened SLA escalation window for enterprise support. Key details:
- ARR estimate: $480k first year (high growth potential)
- Requested commercial exceptions: 30% discount off list for year-1 committed usage
- Requested SLA exception: 99.9% uptime commitment + 1-hour on-call response during business hours (their legal wants this baked in)
- Security asks: SOC2 report + confirmation on KMS integration and data-retention policy (90 days)

We generally have internal guardrails: Max discount frontline can approve is 20% with manager signoff; finance requires deals >$250k to be reviewed by RevOps. SLA exceptions need security/legal signoff.

Requests from me:
1) Marcus - can you approve up to 25% discount for this transit deal (we expect upsell in year 2)? If you need numbers, I can share ARR cadence forecast.
2) Aditya - can you engage RevOps and Finance to prepare the procurement exception form and a signed MSA with proposed SLA deviations?
3) Neha - can Security prioritize SOC2 evidence check and confirm whether the requested SLA language triggers additional controls?

Attachments: acme-procurement-exception-request.pdf (draft exception form), acme-MAP-v1.pdf
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-07

I’m happy to jump on a quick sync if helpful. Customer timeline: they’re aiming to finalize commercial terms in 2-3 weeks.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Acme procurement exception request - discount + SLA (requesting approval)

Marissa - thanks for the full context and the forecast. Quick response:

- Discount: I can provisionally approve up to 25% discount for year-1 committed usage, contingent on RevOps/Finance sign-off and the customer signing a 12-month committed plan with an escalation clause for renewal pricing.
- SLA exception: I'm not comfortable approving SLA language changes without Security and Legal signoff. Neha - please advise whether the 1-hour on-call response and 99.9% uptime ask is feasible or if we should propose a monitoring-based SLA instead.
- Security evidence: Neha, please flag any missing items. If SOC2 is required, ask Security to provide the standard SOC2 package and a short note on any gaps. We should avoid contractual language that creates unlimited exposure.

Action items I’m taking:
- I’ll loop in Finance if RevOps flags any unusual billing terms.
- Marissa - please send the finalized exception form into RevOps and copy me; I’ll expedite approval on my side once Finance signs off.

Approve moving forward to RevOps and Security review.

- Marcus
